verdict.rationale: React's official docs explicitly state you can 'Add React to your existing HTML page' without building a whole app, and GitHub docs note 'you can use as little or as much React as you need,' both directly supporting no-bundler script-tag usage. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the CDN script-tag workflow and explicit mention of production caveats (e.g. JSX requiring a transform when not bundling).
